id: SorchaLula 'Why So Far' EP release tour - Wellington-25 Taranaki St, Te Aro, Wellington 6011-All Events In
name: SorchaLula 'Why So Far' EP release tour - Wellington
long_description:
SorchaLula 'Why So Far' EP release tour - Wellington
SorchaLula unveils her debut EP ‘Why So Far’ on Loop Electronic, celebrating with a release tour of Aotearoa. Expect talented musicians, great sound, creative crews, and venues in the very heart of the scene at every stop. The first gig marks the EP release date of Fri 20 Nov in Te-Whanganui-a-Tara / Wellington, at the hot new club Public Service Center featuring a custom-built Tub’s Audio rig. SorchaLula’s musical collaborators Samuel (vocals) and Merlin Webster (guitar) will perform live with her (as featured on the EP), and the exquisite Zuke (Ed Zuccollo/Loop Records) will add his sonic beauty across the decks and live Minimoog.

Emerging from the Aotearoa underground with a reputation for sensual, slinky and bass-driven DJ sets, SorchaLula’s original music weaves together intricate percussion, field recordings and heavy bass weight. Her sound is emotionally charged and physically grounded, exploring the duality of tenderness and power within the dance music scene. With supple, rolling grooves, weathered textures and organic instrumentation, her first single was hailed as "an impressive debut" by the NZ Listener/NZ Herald. Her second single was picked out by the Spotify editorial team, which is almost unheard of for a newly released producer. With her third single out on Fri 30 Oct, she has already proved she’s one to watch before the full EP is revealed on 20 Nov.

This special night will feature long journey sets voyaging right across the musical spectrum, and multiple live performances, in Wellington's freshest space with great attention paid to sound.
Limited capacity, very limited early birds.

id: Reworking the Work-City Gallery Wellington,101 Wakefield Street, Wellington, New Zealand-All Events In
name: Reworking the Work
venue: City Gallery Wellington,101 Wakefield Street, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Reworking the Work
Pulverise it, cut it, transform it! Four poets respond with haiku to Cornelia Parker’s own ‘haiku’: small-scale artworks that distill big ideas. Parker’s series explores the notions of objects to create new forms and ways of understanding the original items. Expect adventurous reinventions of the poets’ own work. Featuring James Brown, Airini Beautrais, Rebecca Hawkes and Tony DiCarlo.

Big Christmas Sip and Shop
CHRISTMAS SIP, SHOP & CELEBRATE! �

Fashion, festive fun and fabulous finds — all for a great cause!
Get your friends together and join us for a fabulous Christmas shopping experience at Dress for Success Wellington!
Our Christmas Sip & Shop is bringing together fashion, entertainment and festive cheer for a special event filled with style, sparkle and plenty of opportunities to get your Christmas shopping sorted.

Enjoy an exciting fashion show featuring fabulous pre-loved fashion, browse our curated selection of beautiful clothing and accessories, and discover something truly special in our designer wear silent auction. There’ll be entertainment, festive nibbles and drinks, an exciting raffle, and plenty of time to shop, socialise and soak up the Christmas atmosphere.

Whether you’re looking for unique gifts, a gorgeous outfit for the festive season, or simply an excuse for a fun afternoon or evening out with friends, this is one Christmas event you won’t want to miss!

WHAT’S IN STORE?
* Fashion show – inspiration for your festive wardrobe and beyond.
* Christmas shopping – discover fabulous finds at our Dressed Recycled Boutique.
* Designer wear silent auction – your chance to bid on something special.
* Exciting raffle – fabulous prizes up for grabs.
* Festive drinks and nibbles – enjoy a little Christmas indulgence.
* Entertainment – adding extra sparkle to the celebrations.

SHOP WITH PURPOSE
Every purchase helps support the work of Dress for Success Wellington, helping people in our community build confidence, develop their careers and take their next steps towards employment.
When you shop with us, you’re not just finding something fabulous — you’re helping create opportunities for others.
So gather your friends, dress up if you feel like it, raise a glass and join us for a celebration of fashion, community and Christmas generosity.

Come for the shopping. Stay for the fun. Leave knowing you’ve made a difference.
Spaces are limited, so buy your tickets now and celebrate Christmas with us!
